description: The Premiere side of the bridge (CEP extension MCPBridgeCEP). action=status (default, read-only) says whether it is installed and enabled; action=install copies it into the user's CEP extensions folder and enables unsigned CEP extensions (PlayerDebugMode) — ask the user first. After an install the user must quit and reopen Premiere Pro, then call pr_verify. Use when pr_verify reports that the connector does not answer.
name: pr_install_connector
